evals.prompt: Add tests for a replay bug in a multi-module workflow.
evals.expected_output: A minimal reproducer, adjacent near miss, deterministic inputs, side-effect and recovery assertions, and graph-backed test selection.

evals.prompt: Investigate lower pytest collection and execution counts.
evals.expected_output: Exact collected/selected/executed/deselected/skip/xfail counts, root cause, and no baseline update without justification.
